column1: USE OF SYSTEM AGREEMENT (UoSA) TRACKER — Municipal network access map

A UoSA = formal agreement between a trader and a municipality to use its distribution network for wheeling. Without a UoSA, a trader CANNOT serve customers in that municipality. This map shows who has access where.

WHY THIS MATTERS: Municipal network access is a structural competitive advantage. A trader with a UoSA in a municipality has the right to serve ALL C&I customers in that area. A trader without a UoSA must use Eskom's transmission grid only (limiting customer reach). Tracking who has UoSAs where = tracking geographic market control.
